description: Complete guide to Fukuyama, Hiroshima: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Fukuyama is a city in Hiroshima with a population of 465,000. A historic castle city on the Seto Inland Sea with a well-preserved castle, rose gardens, and a strong manufacturing base. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
